text: Mark one non-entry table edge as closed to enemy deployment; the closure lapses when the Round ends.
Seize the First Player Marker immediately; it stays locked to you until the Phase ends.
Check at nomination: refuse if a friendly Unit of the same kind already came in this way earlier in the current Round.
Place a Creep Tumor token up to 6 inches from a Friendly Entry Edge (this includes a friendly Omega Worm base, per F Omega Network) or from one of your tumors; sight is not needed.
Remove a tumor when an opposing Unit ends one of exactly these five actions within 1 inch of it: move, deploy, run, charge, disengage (F: PLACE is not movement).
Army building: the list must include exactly one Creep Card, paid at its listed cost.
Only usable while no friendly Unit of the named type is on the battlefield; the summoned structure may not use Special Abilities (except Structure) this Round.
Once the active Unit is done, choose one more friendly Unit that could still act this Phase and activate it right away.
Every friendly Protoss Unit within 6 inches of the placed Faction Indicator leaves the battlefield for Reserves.
